name: 110 kV substation automation system, reference design (illustrative)
comment: EXAMPLE system record for system-disclosure v0.1, and for the OT overlay ot-system. The reference substation automation system as its integrator delivers it, stage 'configured'. Lists every interface of the two product records it cites, the protection IED and lib60870 (embedded in the substation gateway), each joined to the product interface it realises, with the zone it sits in, the conduit it crosses and the component that provides its keys. The key server, the enrolment service and the gateway itself have no product record. Illustrative values.

Protection IED, bay 1: MMS with role-based access tokens (IEC 62351-4, -8)
Protection IED, bay 1: GDOI group key distribution (IEC 62351-9)
Protection IED, bay 1: Certificate enrolment (EST, IEC 62351-9)
Protection IED, bay 1: Engineering configuration download
Protection IED, bay 1: Device private key and trust anchors
